pack.title: Mogul Money: Season 2, Episode 3
pack.description: A full show adapted from Mogul Money season 2, episode 3 (Valkyrae, Fuslie and Squeex): ten board categories, a Video Games category for Final Trivia and the five Fast Money surveys. Questions are paraphrased. Steam Games and Leaksley are about the show's cast. Four censored language clues are replaced with new ones. Survey numbers are the show's where revealed and illustrative otherwise.
pack.author: Adapted from Mogul Money

categories.title: A Very Chinese Time
categories.blurb: China: its culture, language and history.

clues.question: Which enormous Chinese structure is often wrongly claimed to be visible from space?
What is the capital of China, home to the Forbidden City?
Which valuable Chinese product, described as "white gold", travelled west along an ancient trading network named after it?
clues.notes: The Silk Road. A Red Bull Boost on the show: the contestant said platinum and lost 700.

clues.question: What is the Chinese name for the characters used to write the Chinese language?
clues.notes: Pronounced roughly "hahn-dzuh". Kanji is the Japanese reading of the same word; host's call.

clues.question: Which animal of the Chinese zodiac represents the year 2026?
clues.notes: 2026 is the year of the Fire Horse, starting on 17 February.

categories.title: Steam Games
categories.blurb: Show-specific: games on Steam and the cast's Steam libraries.

clues.question: Which tactical first-person shooter is the game in which Ludwig has the lowest rank of anyone on the show?
Which sequel to a popular pizzeria-themed horror game received Squeex's only negative review on Steam?
clues.notes: "Five Nights at Freddy's" without the 2 is the host's call.

clues.question: Which social-deduction game is said to have peaked above four million concurrent players in September 2020 and is Valkyrae's most-played game?
Which co-op game does Ludwig enthusiastically promote as his favourite game of all time?
Which strategy game, in which teams of adorable animals battle one another, has Ludwig played more than any other on Steam?

categories.title: AI
categories.blurb: Every answer contains the letters A-I in a row.

clues.question: Which short form of Japanese poetry traditionally follows a five-seven-five syllable pattern?
What do you call a depiction of a person that concentrates on their face and head?
Which compound gives chilli peppers their heat?
Which dark-purple berry is often promoted as a superfood because of its antioxidants?
clues.notes: Pronounced "ah-sah-EE".

clues.question: Which geographical term describes a narrow waterway linking two larger bodies of water?
clues.notes: "Channel" fits the definition but has no A-I.

categories.title: It's a Date
categories.blurb: Holidays and the days they fall on.

clues.question: Which annual celebration of romantic love falls on 14 February?
Which date is commemorated in the United States with the phrase "Never forget"?
Which US federal holiday in January honours a leader of the civil-rights movement?
clues.notes: The third Monday of January.

clues.question: In which month does the United States celebrate Labor Day, on the first Monday?
Which US federal holiday, made official in 2021, commemorates the end of slavery in the United States?

categories.title: Keep Yourself Safe
categories.blurb: Name the language. Every word here means "sorry".

clues.question: In which language does "désolé" mean "sorry"?
clues.notes: The only clue in this category that survived the show's edit. Say it "day-zo-LAY".

clues.question: In which language does "lo siento" mean "sorry"?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: the original clue was cut from the video. Say it "lo see-EN-toh".

clues.question: In which language does "Entschuldigung" mean "sorry"?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: the original clue was cut from the video. Say it "ent-SHOOL-dee-goong".

clues.question: In which language does "gomen nasai" mean "sorry"?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: the original clue was censored. Say it "go-men nah-sigh".

clues.question: In which language does "przepraszam" mean "sorry"?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: the original clue was never picked. Say it "psheh-PRAH-shahm".

categories.title: Who's That Pogemon
categories.blurb: Name the Twitch emote from its description.

clues.question: Which emote, typed as one letter and one digit, shows a salute?
clues.notes: A silhouette on the show. Add the emote image in the pack editor to play it that way.

clues.question: Which emote, a three-letter word in capitals, shows a confused yellow face with its hands raised?
clues.notes: A silhouette on the show.

clues.question: Which emote shows a smug yellow character, named Jupie, with its fists held together?
clues.notes: A silhouette on the show. The name is as the show revealed it.

clues.question: Which emote, named after the scream it is making, shows a wide-eyed, startled face?
clues.notes: A silhouette on the show. Be generous with the number of As.

clues.question: Which emote shows a winking character making finger guns?
clues.notes: A silhouette on the show.

categories.title: Inbreeding
categories.blurb: Genetics, royal families and people who married their cousins.

clues.question: Which molecule carries the genetic information responsible for inherited characteristics?
Which evolutionary process is commonly summed up by the phrase "survival of the fittest"?
clues.notes: "Evolution" alone is the host's call.

clues.question: Which Habsburg monarch, famous for his severe hereditary health problems, was the dynasty's last king of Spain?
clues.notes: He died without an heir in 1700, which set off the War of the Spanish Succession.

clues.question: Which pioneering naturalist developed the theory of natural selection and married his first cousin?
clues.notes: He married Emma Wedgwood in 1839. A Red Bull Boost on the show.

clues.question: Name one of the two US states that, according to the show, do not criminalise consensual incest between adults.
clues.notes: Either one is enough. This is the show's claim, not a full statement of current state law.

categories.title: Counter-Strike Arsenal
categories.blurb: Every answer is a weapon or knife from Counter-Strike.

clues.question: What is the name of Counter-Strike's iconic high-powered sniper rifle that kills with one shot?
clues.notes: Said "awp", to rhyme with "stop".

clues.question: Which powerful handgun is often nicknamed the pocket sniper?
Which scoped assault rifle became notoriously powerful during the "Krieg" meta of 2019?
Which revolver was so powerful when it was released in 2015 that it needed an emergency balance update?
clues.notes: "The revolver" is the host's call, since the question gives that much away.

clues.question: Which type of knife was involved in a Counter-Strike skin deal that the show valued at about $1.5 million?
clues.notes: The Case Hardened Karambit, pattern #387, known as the "Blue Gem". Only the knife type is needed.

categories.title: Leaksley
categories.blurb: Show-specific: things the cast leaked or let slip on stream.

clues.question: Which actor, a star of "A Minecraft Movie", was the answer to a clue about leaked information involving the film's catchphrases?
clues.notes: The clue was reworded mid-show and caused confusion with Jack Black. Jason Momoa was the accepted answer.

clues.question: Which major video platform was accidentally revealed as the place Fuslie was moving her streams to?
Which production company associated with Ludwig reportedly lost around $3 million before that became public?
For which soft-drink brand did Fuslie accidentally reveal promotional discount codes earlier than she was meant to?
Which name connects a controversial online streaming persona and a member of FSLR?
clues.notes: As given on the show; an in-joke for viewers. FSLR is the Counter-Strike team of Fuslie, Squeex, Ludwig and Valkyrae.

categories.title: Famous Balds
categories.blurb: Well-known people without much on top.

clues.question: Which bald billionaire is best known for founding Amazon?
Which former WWE champion turned Hollywood actor is also behind Teremana Tequila?
Which bald musician goes by the nickname "Mr. Worldwide"?
Which bald comedian and television personality is famous for presenting "Family Feud"?
Which player, drafted third overall in 1984, won six NBA Finals MVP awards?

categories.title: Video Games
categories.blurb: The show's Final Trivia category. Pick it for Final Trivia and the last clue is asked.

clues.question: Which company makes the PlayStation consoles?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: In which battle royale game do players jump into each match from the Battle Bus?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: Which hero shooter has the higher all-time peak player count on Steam: "Overwatch" or "Marvel Rivals"?
clues.notes: The show's tiebreaker, turned into a question. Its figures: Marvel Rivals 644,000, Overwatch 165,000.

clues.question: Which Polish studio developed both "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt" and "Cyberpunk 2077"?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: Which team-based shooter has the highest all-time concurrent player count on Steam?
clues.notes: The show's Final Trivia question. It peaked above 3.2 million in January 2018. Nobody on the show got it.

surveys.question: Who is the worst video game player in FSLR?
How many days a week do you shower?
What is a normal price for a cup of coffee, to the nearest dollar?
Who is the best character in Mario Party?
Which video game are you best at?
